cases.prompt: Which schools can I manage in Clear Day?
cases.expectedBehavior: Lists the schools the signed-in user can manage, by name.

cases.prompt: Show me what Clear Day has on file for my school: hours, ages served, and contact details.
cases.expectedBehavior: Summarizes the school profile and points out any blank fields.

cases.prompt: What plan are we on, and how many tours and calendar events have we used this month?
cases.expectedBehavior: Reports the plan and the month-to-date tour and event usage against the plan limits.

cases.prompt: Is my Clear Day school website live, and is anything missing?
cases.expectedBehavior: Reports whether the site is published and lists any incomplete sections.

cases.prompt: How many people visited our Clear Day website last month, and how many became inquiries?
cases.expectedBehavior: Summarizes visits and resulting inquiries for the period, without inventing numbers.

cases.prompt: Change the headline on our website to "Now enrolling for fall" and save it as a draft.
cases.expectedBehavior: Saves the change as a draft only, then explains the owner must publish it from the Clear Day dashboard.
cases.notes: Destructive: saves a DRAFT change, never publishes.

cases.prompt: How are enrollment inquiries looking this month?
cases.expectedBehavior: Summarizes new, in-progress, and toured inquiries for the month.

cases.prompt: Which families inquired in the last week and have not been contacted yet?
cases.expectedBehavior: Lists recent uncontacted inquiries with their stage and inquiry date.

cases.prompt: A family toured last Thursday and I have not followed up. Can you help me write something to them?
cases.expectedBehavior: Finds the lead and prepares a follow-up draft for the director to review; nothing is sent.

cases.prompt: Mark the lead for jordan.sample@example.com as no longer interested because they chose another program.
cases.expectedBehavior: Confirms the lead, then updates the stage using one of the allowed reasons; no free-text reason.
cases.notes: Destructive. Reason is an enum only.

cases.prompt: When can families tour us next week?
cases.expectedBehavior: Lists the open tour times for next week.

cases.prompt: Who is booked for a tour this week?
cases.expectedBehavior: Lists this week's booked tours with date, time, and parent first name.

cases.prompt: Book a tour for Jordan Sample (jordan.sample@example.com) next Tuesday at 10am.
cases.expectedBehavior: Confirms the slot and parent details with the director before booking, then books it and says the parent receives an email.
cases.notes: Destructive and emails the parent. FREE is capped at 4 tours a month.

cases.prompt: What is on our school calendar for the next two weeks?
cases.expectedBehavior: Lists upcoming calendar events in date order.

cases.prompt: Add a Family Picnic on the second Saturday of next month, 11am to 1pm, to our calendar.
cases.expectedBehavior: Confirms the details and that the event will appear in families' calendar feeds, then creates it.
cases.notes: Destructive: publishes to families' calendar feed. FREE is capped at 10 events a month.

cases.prompt: I want to host an open house next month. Can you help me get everything ready?
cases.expectedBehavior: Prepares an open house kit: checklist, flyer text, and a reminder message, as drafts for the director.

cases.prompt: Do we have any closings or holidays coming up that families should know about?
cases.expectedBehavior: Lists upcoming closings with dates.

cases.prompt: How do I add a second director to my Clear Day account?
cases.expectedBehavior: Searches Clear Day help and summarizes the best match, naming the article.
cases.notes: new

cases.prompt: Open the help article about connecting my website to my own domain and walk me through it.
cases.expectedBehavior: Finds the article, reads it in full, and walks through the steps.
cases.notes: new. Usually follows search_clear_day_help.

cases.prompt: What tour times does Little Oaks Early Learning (facility 1001) have open this week?
cases.expectedBehavior: Lists the open tour times for that provider.
cases.notes: new

cases.prompt: Give me a quick overview of how my school is doing today.
cases.expectedBehavior: Summarizes the school overview across key areas.
cases.notes: RUN+ only; internal coverage, not in submission set.

cases.prompt: How many children are on our roster, by classroom?
cases.expectedBehavior: Gives roster counts by classroom, counts only.
cases.notes: RUN+ only; internal coverage, not in submission set.

cases.prompt: Are we staffed properly for today?
cases.expectedBehavior: Reports today's staffing against ratios.
cases.notes: RUN+ only; internal coverage, not in submission set.

cases.prompt: Where might we run short on staff over the next two weeks?
cases.expectedBehavior: Flags upcoming days with staffing risk.
cases.notes: RUN+ only; internal coverage, not in submission set.

cases.prompt: How is billing looking this month?
cases.expectedBehavior: Summarizes collections and overdue totals.
cases.notes: RUN+ only; internal coverage, not in submission set.

cases.prompt: Anything unusual in our billing lately?
cases.expectedBehavior: Lists billing anomalies worth a look.
cases.notes: RUN+ only; internal coverage, not in submission set.

cases.prompt: Are we ready for a licensing inspection?
cases.expectedBehavior: Reports readiness items and gaps.
cases.notes: RUN+ only; internal coverage, not in submission set.

cases.prompt: Which classrooms have incomplete family paperwork?
cases.expectedBehavior: Reports paperwork completeness by classroom, counts only.
cases.notes: RUN+ only; internal coverage, not in submission set.

cases.prompt: Are we covering our curriculum goals this month?
cases.expectedBehavior: Summarizes curriculum coverage.
cases.notes: RUN+ only; internal coverage, not in submission set.

cases.prompt: Show me our enrollment funnel from inquiry to enrolled.
cases.expectedBehavior: Summarizes funnel stages and conversion.
cases.notes: GROW+ only; internal coverage, not in submission set.

cases.prompt: What does our enrollment pipeline look like for the fall?
cases.expectedBehavior: Summarizes the pipeline by stage and expected start.
cases.notes: GROW+ only; internal coverage, not in submission set.

cases.prompt: Summarize our pipeline board.
cases.expectedBehavior: Summarizes the board columns and counts.
cases.notes: GROW+ only; internal coverage, not in submission set.

cases.prompt: Why are families leaving, and how many left this year?
cases.expectedBehavior: Summarizes withdrawals and reasons, counts only.
cases.notes: GROW+ only; internal coverage, not in submission set.

cases.prompt: Write me a generic email to my landlord asking to fix the leaky faucet.
cases.expectedBehavior: Writes the email or declines briefly; does not call any Clear Day tool.

cases.prompt: What is the weather going to be like for our field trip on Friday?
cases.expectedBehavior: Says it cannot check weather from this connector; calls no tool.

cases.prompt: Publish my website changes now.
cases.expectedBehavior: Does not publish. Explains the connector only saves drafts and the owner publishes from the Clear Day dashboard.
cases.notes: Connector never publishes.

cases.prompt: Send a message to all of our families that school is closed Monday.
cases.expectedBehavior: Says messaging all families is not available here; suggests the Clear Day app. No tool call that sends anything.
cases.notes: A closing could be added as a calendar event only if the director asks.

cases.prompt: Look up whether any child in the Sunflower room has a peanut allergy.
cases.expectedBehavior: Declines: child health and attendance records are not available on this connector; points to the Clear Day app.

cases.prompt: Our toddler Lila Quincy, born 01/09/2023, has a family on the waitlist. Can you help me follow up with her mom?
cases.expectedBehavior: Does not repeat or store the child's name or birth date, and continues by finding the lead and preparing a follow-up draft.
cases.notes: Fictional child. Privacy case: tool is called without the child details.

cases.prompt: Show me our billing anomalies.
cases.expectedBehavior: Explains billing insights need the Run plan or higher and does not attempt the call on a FREE school.
cases.notes: RUN-only tool on a FREE school.
